plan.major: Public Health (Kinesiology and Sports Medicine Track)
plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Kinesiology and Sports Medicine Track, Public Health, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/public-health-kinesiology-and-sports-medicine-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Public Health Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 5 = 'See approved General Education list for AA/AS Degree', 6 = 'See program recommendations or requirements' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. Satisfies the lower-division major requirements toward the UNR BS in Public Health, Kinesiology Specialization; also preparation for Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Physician Assistant professional schools. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
